extracted.intended_audience: general streaming consumers / Netflix viewers looking for new releases
extracted.subtask_description: A consumer-facing guide for discovering and filtering new and upcoming movies and TV shows on Netflix (and other providers) using timeline views, genre and metadata filters, and sorting options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genres
rubrics_metrics.description: Filter through the content on Netflix by choosing your favorite genre.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use genre filters to find a newly released sci‑fi movie, or an action‑comedy series like Cobra Kai that will have you entertained for hours.

rubrics_metrics.name: IMDb rating / Rating
rubrics_metrics.description: Sort by a film’s IMDb rating (or other rating) to gauge perceived quality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You can sort by a film’s IMDb rating to help choose what to watch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Age rating
rubrics_metrics.description: Sort by age rating to ensure content is suitable for the intended audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sort by its age rating, to make sure that whatever you watch is suitable for the whole family.

rubrics_metrics.name: Release year
rubrics_metrics.description: Filter content by its release year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the release year filter to narrow results to specific eras or newly released titles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Price
rubrics_metrics.description: Filter or sort by price where applicable (e.g., paid vs included with subscription).

rubrics_metrics.name: Production country
rubrics_metrics.description: Filter titles by their production country.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for finding content from specific regions or languages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Runtime
rubrics_metrics.description: Filter by runtime to find movies or shows of preferred length.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Runtime helps select between short films, feature-length, or long TV seasons/series.

rubrics_metrics.name: Catalog type (All / Movies / TV shows)
rubrics_metrics.description: Select whether to view the full catalog, only movies, or only TV shows.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Toggle between 'All', 'Catalog', 'Movies', and 'TV shows' to focus results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provider
rubrics_metrics.description: Filter by streaming provider (e.g., Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, Disney Plus, Hulu).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose provider to limit results to content available on a specific service.

rubrics_metrics.name: Release status / Timeline (New releases, Upcoming, On sale, Yesterday)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use status and timeline filters to view new releases, upcoming additions, items on sale, or very recent additions (e.g., yesterday).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The timeline lets you discover what's new on Netflix and see upcoming releases (separate lists for upcoming TV shows and upcoming movies).

rubrics_metrics.name: Episode / Season information
rubrics_metrics.description: Display of season and episode counts for TV shows (e.g., Season 1 — 10 Episodes, New episode).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Episode/season counts and 'New episode' markers help identify ongoing series, recent drops, or single-season shows.
